capex: Q1 FY27 is an important quarter for us because this quarter we have achieved a great milestone marked by strong financial performance, successful capacity expansion, and disciplined execution.
As many of you may recall, we commissioned an additional 2,000 metric tons of production capacity in January 2025, taking our total installed capacity to 6,500 metric tons.
focus: Our continued focus on strategic expansion, customer-centric innovation, operational excellence, and disciplined execution continues to drive strong business performance.
